description: This file implements a support module for calculating MCS (Modulation and Coding Scheme) based on CQI (Channel Quality Indicator) and SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) for 3GPP LTE/5G NR systems. It includes mappings from CQI to MCS, and functions to determine the maximum MCS for given SNR values, referencing 3GPP specifications and spectral efficiency tables.

methods.name: ocudu::map_cqi_to_mcs
methods.description: Maps CQI value to MCS index based on specified MCS table, returning an optional MCS index.

methods.name: ocudu::map_snr_to_mcs_ul
methods.description: Determines the maximum MCS index that can be used for a given uplink SNR, considering MCS tables and optional transform precoder.
